literal: Ruin not-knowing, even in ruined condition prosperity undiminishing country, they say, of countries the foremost.
translation: A country that knows no ruin, and whose prosperity does not diminish even if it suffers a setback, is said to be the foremost among nations.
modern: அழிவை அறியாததும், ஒருவேளை அழிவு வந்த காலத்திலும் தன் வளம் குறையாததுமான நாடே நாடுகளுள் தலைசிறந்தது என்று கூறுவர்.
explanation: This couplet defines the supreme qualities of an ideal nation. The key phrase 'கேடறியா' (knowing no ruin) highlights a land so secure and well-governed that it is free from external invasions and internal disasters. Even if some misfortune or temporary setback ('கெட்ட இடத்தும்') does occur, its inherent strength ensures that its prosperity ('வளம்') remains undiminished ('குன்றா'). Such a resilient and self-sustaining land is declared by wise people to be the crown or foremost ('தலை') among all countries.
